llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The new SyncWithCallback method should be added to BucketStore in pkg/storegateway/bucket.go, wrapping the existing syncBlocks logic to invoke a callback function for each block's metadata during synchronization. The callback will receive *block.Meta objects defined in pkg/storage/tsdb/block/meta.go, and all wrapper/mock implementations must be updated to support this method signature.

FILES:
- mimir/pkg/storegateway/bucket.go — Contains BucketStore struct and SyncBlocks method; primary location for adding SyncWithCallback
- mimir/pkg/storage/tsdb/block/meta.go — Defines the Meta struct used as the callback parameter
- mimir/pkg/storegateway/bucket_stores.go — Manages multi-tenant BucketStore instances that may need to support the new method
- thanos/pkg/store/bucket.go — Reference implementation for Mimir's BucketStore
- thanos/pkg/block/metadata/meta.go — Reference metadata structure (Mimir has its own version)
